runners.name: documenso_app_tests_playwright_api
argv: set -euo pipefail; NEXT_PRIVATE_DATABASE_URL="${NEXT_PRIVATE_DATABASE_URL:?Set NEXT_PRIVATE_DATABASE_URL}" NEXT_PRIVATE_DIRECT_DATABASE_URL="${NEXT_PRIVATE_DIRECT_DATABASE_URL:?Set NEXT_PRIVATE_DIRECT_DATABASE_URL}" DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:?Set DATABASE_URL}" npm run prisma:migrate-deploy -w @documenso/prisma; coverage_build_key="$({ git rev-parse HEAD; git diff HEAD --binary -- apps packages; printf '%s' 'oracle-documenso-build-v1'; } | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')"; if [ ! -f apps/remix/build/.oracle_coverage_build_ready ] || [ "$(cat apps/remix/build/.oracle_coverage_build_ready)" != "$coverage_build_key" ]; then trap 'git checkout -- apps/remix/rollup.config.mjs apps/remix/vite.config.ts packages/lib/translations' EXIT; npm run translate; perl -0pi -e 's/noEmitOnError: true/noEmitOnError: false/' apps/remix/rollup.config.mjs; node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='apps/remix/vite.config.ts'; const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); if (!s.includes('sourcemap: true')) fs.writeFileSync(p, s.replace(/build:\\s*\\{/, 'build: {\n    sourcemap: true,'));"; NODE_ENV=production npm exec --workspace @documenso/remix -- react-router build; npm run build:server --workspace @documenso/remix; mkdir -p apps/remix/build/server/hono/packages/lib; cp apps/remix/server/main.js apps/remix/build/server/main.js; rm -rf apps/remix/build/server/hono/packages/lib/translations; cp -r packages/lib/translations apps/remix/build/server/hono/packages/lib/translations; printf '%s\n' "$coverage_build_key" > apps/remix/build/.oracle_coverage_build_ready; fi; npm exec --workspace @documenso/app-tests -- start-server-and-test "npm run start -w @documenso/remix" http://localhost:3000 "cd ../.. && npm exec -- playwright test --config packages/app-tests/playwright.config.ts {{test_file}} --project=api --workers=1 --retries=0 --reporter=line"
